Granted — the lane is carrying on.

Only an admin can grant more. Tell an admin; the lane resumes on its own once granted.
Lane nào chạm 100% một hạn mức áp lên nó: A lane that reaches 100% of any limit on it stops at once: its chat says so, it makes no AI call and takes no new feature, and waits for an admin to grant more. From the warning level the lane keeps working, but its chat is warned first.
